not_found.title: No Devices Found
not_found.description: No Velit devices were found nearby. If the Velit mobile app is open on any nearby phone, close it and tap Try Again.

manual.title: Add Velit Device
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth address of your Velit device.

device_type.title: Configure Device
device_type.description: Select the device type and give it a name to identify it in Home Assistant.

error.invalid_address: Invalid Bluetooth address. Enter a MAC address like AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF (or a UUID on macOS hosts).

device_fault.title: {device_name}: {fault_code_display} {fault_name}
device_fault.description:
The device is reporting **{fault_code_display} — {fault_name}**.

Check the device and clear the fault before restarting the heater.

data.unavailable_on_fault: Show device as unavailable when fault is active
data.self_heal_hours: Self-heal after the heater temperature is unchanged for (hours)

data_description.self_heal_enabled: When the heater's temperature reading stops changing in Standby (the Error 16 signature), re-send the current setpoint to clear it. The setpoint itself does not change.
data_description.self_heal_hours: Longer for heaters boxed in or shaded, shorter for heaters open to the cabin.
data_description.self_heal_ref_entity: Another temperature sensor in the same space. If it moves by the deviation below while the heater's reading holds still, self-heal right away.
data_description.self_heal_ref_delta: How far the reference sensor must move, in your Home Assistant temperature unit. Default 5 °F (3 °C).
data_description.self_heal_altitude: If the vehicle moves up or down by the altitude change below while the heater's reading holds still, self-heal right away.
data_description.self_heal_alt_delta: Feet if Home Assistant uses °F, metres if °C. Default 100 ft (30 m); parked readings wobble about 10 ft.
